Compatibility mode: the system does not let Shizuku create a trusted virtual display (no ADD_TRUSTED_DISPLAY). The agent screen still works, with limits: tapping a text field may open the keyboard on your screen; an app that jumps to another app may show it on your screen before it is moved back; when your screen turns off the agent screen turns off too and waits until it is on again.
